description: FitRank PRD 10-phase build queue. Kick off with prompts[0] manually; stop hook auto-feeds prompts[1..9].
prompts:
PHASE 1 - Project Scaffolding & Environment

Read PRD_Redrob_FitRank.md Section 10 Phase 1 and Section 11 (Repository Structure).

Implement:
- Directory structure: fitrank/, tests/, app/, scripts/, config/, outputs/, data/, docs/, deck/
- requirements.txt (Python 3.11+, pytest, streamlit, pyyaml)
- config/weights.yaml with all 5 component weights from PRD Section 7 (sum ≈ 1.0)
- fitrank/__init__.py, README.md stub, Makefile, submission_metadata.yaml stub
- Update .gitignore for __pycache__, outputs/, .env (keep data/candidates.jsonl via LFS)
- tests/test_phase1_setup.py covering T1.1-T1.7

Exit criteria: pip install works; `python -c "import fitrank; print('OK')"` prints OK; all 9 directories exist.

When done:
1. Mark Phase 1 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run: pytest tests/test_phase1_setup.py -v
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 1: project scaffolding and environment"
4. git push origin main
5. Report summary and stop - do NOT start Phase 2.

PHASE 2 - Data Layer & Candidate Models

Read PRD Phase 2. Implement fitrank/models.py and fitrank/loader.py.

Implement dataclasses: Candidate, CareerEntry, Skill, RedrobSignals, RoleProfile, CandidateScore.
- Generator-based JSONL streaming in load_candidates(path)
- load_sample() for data/sample_candidates.json
- Skip malformed lines with warning; validate against data/candidate_schema.json

Add tests/test_phase2_loader.py covering T2.1-T2.9.

Exit criteria: all 100K candidates stream without crash; memory stays under 2GB during streaming.

When done:
1. Mark Phase 2 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run: pytest tests/test_phase2_loader.py -v
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 2: data layer and candidate models"
4. git push origin main
5. Report summary and stop - do NOT start Phase 3.

PHASE 3 - Job Description Parser

Read PRD Phase 3. Implement fitrank/jd_parser.py with parse_jd(text) -> RoleProfile.

Extract: target_titles, required_capabilities, seniority, min_experience_years, domain, preferred_work_mode.
- Create data/job_description.txt from docs/job_description.docx content (extract text)
- Save parsed profile to outputs/role_profile.json
- Empty JD fallback with warning

Add tests/test_phase3_jd_parser.py covering T3.1-T3.10.

Exit criteria: ≥3 capabilities extracted; different JDs produce different RoleProfiles.

When done:
1. Mark Phase 3 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run: pytest tests/test_phase3_jd_parser.py -v
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 3: job description parser"
4. git push origin main
5. Report summary and stop - do NOT start Phase 4.

PHASE 4 - Title Gate & Domain Classifier

Read PRD Phase 4 and Appendix A. Implement fitrank/title_gate.py.

Implement:
- TitleDomain enum: ML_AI, SOFTWARE, AI_ADJACENT, NON_TECH
- classify_title(title) -> TitleDomain (AI Specialist = AI_ADJACENT, not ML_AI)
- title_jd_match() fuzzy match against RoleProfile.target_titles (0.0–1.0)
- title_domain_bonus per PRD

Add tests/test_phase4_title_gate.py covering T4.1-T4.12.

Exit criteria: all 100K candidates classified; no None domains.

When done:
1. Mark Phase 4 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run: pytest tests/test_phase4_title_gate.py -v
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 4: title gate and domain classifier"
4. git push origin main
5. Report summary and stop - do NOT start Phase 5.

PHASE 5 - Career Evidence Analyzer

Read PRD Phase 5 and Appendices B, C, D. Implement fitrank/career_analyzer.py.

Implement:
- Deep ML regex patterns (~20) and shallow AI boilerplate patterns (~8)
- score_career_ml_depth(), score_current_role_depth(), template domain classifier
- score_career_momentum() from company_size progression
- CareerEvidence dataclass with normalized 0.0–1.0 subscores

Add tests/test_phase5_career.py covering T5.1-T5.12.

Exit criteria: genuine ML profiles score high; template-only traps score current_role_ml_depth == 0.

When done:
1. Mark Phase 5 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run: pytest tests/test_phase5_career.py -v
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 5: career evidence analyzer"
4. git push origin main
5. Report summary and stop - do NOT start Phase 6.

PHASE 6 - Profile Coherence Engine

Read PRD Phase 6. Implement fitrank/coherence.py.

Implement:
- template_coherence_score(), skill_career_alignment(), domain compatibility matrix
- Hard cap: NON_TECH title + career_ml_depth < 2 + current_role_ml_depth < 1 → coherence ≤ 0.15
- is_honeypot flag when coherence < 0.2 AND NON_TECH AND career_ml_depth ≥ 5
- CoherenceScore dataclass per PRD Section 7 Component C

Add tests/test_phase6_coherence.py covering T6.1-T6.11 (include CAND_0004989 trap and CAND_0033861 genuine).

When done:
1. Mark Phase 6 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run: pytest tests/test_phase6_coherence.py -v
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 6: profile coherence engine"
4. git push origin main
5. Report summary and stop - do NOT start Phase 7.

PHASE 7 - Skill Trust & Penalty Layer

Read PRD Phase 7. Implement fitrank/skill_trust.py and fitrank/penalties.py.

Implement:
- Trusted ML skill: duration_months ≥ 12 AND endorsements > 0
- skill_inflation_risk, template_mismatch, shallow_boilerplate, expert_zero_endorse penalties
- total_penalty clamped ≤ 0.70

Add tests/test_phase7_skills.py covering T7.1-T7.11.

When done:
1. Mark Phase 7 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run: pytest tests/test_phase7_skills.py -v
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 7: skill trust and penalty layer"
4. git push origin main
5. Report summary and stop - do NOT start Phase 8.

PHASE 8 - Redrob Signals & Platform Trust

Read PRD Phase 8 and docs/redrob_signals_doc.docx. Implement fitrank/signals.py.

Implement PlatformTrustScore:
- assessment_avg, assessment_jd_overlap, github_norm, engagement_composite, verification_score, availability_score
- Normalize engagement signals at 95th percentile (store constants in config/)
- Missing assessments → neutral 0.0, not penalized

Add tests/test_phase8_signals.py covering T8.1-T8.12.

When done:
1. Mark Phase 8 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run: pytest tests/test_phase8_signals.py -v
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 8: Redrob signals and platform trust"
4. git push origin main
5. Report summary and stop - do NOT start Phase 9.

PHASE 9 - Ranker, Reasoning & Output

Read PRD Phase 9 and Section 7 scoring formulas. Implement fitrank/ranker.py, fitrank/reasoning.py, and rank.py CLI.

Implement:
- Aggregate all component scores; final_score = weighted sum − penalties, clamped 0.0–1.0
- Top 100 sort with tie-break by candidate_id ascending
- Reasoning template: {title} | JD={jd:.2f} Career={ce:.2f} Coh={coh:.2f} Trust={pt:.2f} | {evidence_note} | {penalty_note}
- CLI: python rank.py --candidates data/candidates.jsonl --jd data/job_description.txt --out outputs/submission.csv
- Auto-run validate_submission.py; write outputs/audit_report.json
- Exclude known traps CAND_0004989, CAND_0000339 from top 100

Add tests/test_phase9_ranker.py covering T9.1-T9.14.

When done:
1. Mark Phase 9 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run full pipeline + pytest tests/test_phase9_ranker.py -v
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 9: ranker, reasoning, and submission output"
4. git push origin main
5. Report summary and stop - do NOT start Phase 10.

PHASE 10 - Demo, Docs & Final QA

Read PRD Phase 10 and Section 16 (PDF deck outline).

Implement:
- app/streamlit_app.py with JD input, score breakdown bars, trap examples toggle, CSV export
- scripts/audit_shortlist.py
- Complete README.md (install, reproduce, architecture, test commands)
- Complete submission_metadata.yaml
- deck/Redrob_FitRank_Approach.pdf (10 slides per PRD Appendix F)
- tests/test_phase10_integration.py + ensure pytest tests/ -v passes
- git tag v1.0

Exit criteria: validator passes; pipeline < 5 min; Streamlit runs; no hardcoded absolute paths.

When done:
1. Mark Phase 10 [x] in .cursor/tasks.md
2. Run: pytest tests/ -v && python validate_submission.py outputs/submission.csv
3. git add -A && git commit -m "Phase 10: demo, docs, and final QA"
4. git push origin main && git push origin v1.0
5. Report final deliverables checklist from PRD Section 12 and stop.
